faqs.question: Why can't we just direct traffic to our company homepage?
faqs.answer: Homepages have too many navigation choices, links, and general explanations. They are built to introduce the entire business, not convert specific ad traffic. Landing pages have one purpose. They remove distractions, match the exact message of the ad clicked, and double conversion efficiency.

faqs.question: What is server-side tracking and why is it mandatory now?
faqs.answer: Browser-based tracking cookies are blocked by modern browsers (Safari, Firefox), ad blockers, and mobile operating system privacy settings. This leads to lost attribution data. Server-side tracking routes event data directly from our secure cloud server to the ad platform's endpoint, bypassing browser-level blocks.

faqs.question: Which advertising channels do you work with?
faqs.answer: We focus on Google Search, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta Ads. Google Search captures users already looking for a solution. LinkedIn targets precise corporate titles and industry demographics. Meta is highly effective for cost-efficient retargeting and creative demand generation.

faqs.question: What is your recommended minimum monthly ad spend?
faqs.answer: We recommend starting with at least $3,000 per month. Lower budgets do not generate enough visitor data quickly enough for statistical significance in ad testing and machine-learning optimization.

faqs.question: How do you avoid wasting budget on low-quality search terms?
faqs.answer: We use exact-match and phrase-match keywords. We construct exhaustive lists of negative terms before launching any campaign. We analyze actual search queries daily. We strip budget from non-converting keywords and reallocate it to high-intent transactional terms.

faqs.question: Do you write the copy and build the visual assets for the ads?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team writes all high-converting ad copy, designs visual graphics, and edits short-form videos. We build multiple variations of every asset to test different value propositions for your buyer demographics.

faqs.question: Who owns the ad accounts and landing page assets?
faqs.answer: You do. We build everything inside your existing Google, Meta, or LinkedIn business managers. The custom landing page source code is delivered to your repository. If you choose to stop working with us, you retain all data, setups, and assets.

faqs.question: How do you measure campaign success and revenue outcomes?
faqs.answer: We do not report on 'likes' or 'shares'. We track cost-per-lead, pipeline pipeline value, qualified bookings, and direct return-on-ad-spend (ROAS). We connect our tracking to your CRM (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) to track actual closed deals.
